verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a first-party batch-job feature that runs large SQL operations as batches of retryable tasks. It shows live progress and lets you pause, retry, or cancel while the job runs. Agents can also issue set-based SQL across many rows through the official MCP server's run-SQL tool. Missing for 10: confirmation that agents can launch and control batch jobs via MCP or API, detailed docs on batch-job scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
